text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Damn it! I couldn't win again!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for someone like Epiphaneia, 
back-to-back losses must take their toll. 
She's been venting her frustration over 
and over for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"They were strong. I know that! Even so, I 
know I'm supposed to have the power to 
win!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no doubt about that.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The direction we're headed 
in is definitely not wrong.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's just that right now, I don't have 
enough ability.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's why— let's not get distracted and 
become stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If my skills aren't enough right now, I 
just have to build up the strength to 
win!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And by winning the next race, let's prove 
that everything we've done up to now 
wasn't a mistake!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that makes me can't 
wait for the next race! Don't you think so 
too, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm already looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd say that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's head right back and 
train!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Starting right now! After all, being on a 
losing streak doesn't feel very good at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I want to move forward while the fire in 
my heart is still burning hot. There's no 
time to dawdle! Let's go, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those parting words, Epiphaneia 
bolted off, and I rushed after her to stop 
her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know that! Winning is 
hands-down the best way to move people's 
hearts!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. I've got this. After all, 
lady luck is on my side!"
